title: Immune Status SARS-CoV-2 in a Sample of a Tertiary Eye Health Centre
brief_summary: A sequential combination of different antibodies test against SARS-CoV-2 is evaluated. The protocol included a rapid test and several ELISA tests within a defined cohort of healthcare workers.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Employees of the health facility described
* voluntary request for testing

Exclusion Criteria:

\- None
study_population: Employee of the Department of Ophthalmology (at a university institution)
